title: Just Juice Bar Range Strawberry & Kiwi 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry and Kiwi from the Just Juice Bar Range delivers a classic fruit pairing with a cool edge. The inhale brings juicy, sun-ripened Strawberry notes, quickly followed by the tangy brightness of Kiwi. A clean layer of Ice rounds out the blend for a sweet yet refreshing finish that’s perfect for all-day vaping. This nicotine salt e-liquid provides rapid nicotine delivery with a smoother, more tactile throat hit than traditional freebase e-liquids. It’s blended at 60PG/40VG and available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. Made in the UK, Just Juice Bar Range Nic Salts are inspired by the vibrant sweetness and cooling intensity of disposable-style flavours, but delivered in a refillable 10ml format designed for long-term use. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
